name: e2-cyclic-quotient-mld-3
question: For each isolated cyclic quotient 3-fold germ 1/r(a, b, c) with r <= 40, is the germ terminal exactly when two weights add to 0 mod r (the terminal lemma), and is the mld of each terminal germ 1 + 1/r?
result: agrees: in 1747 germs of dimension 3, a germ is terminal exactly when two weights add to 0 mod r, and each terminal germ has the mld 1 + 1/r
